"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/redistribute-characters-to-make-all-strings-equal/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1897. Redistribute Characters to Make All Strings Equal

You are given an array of strings words (0-indexed).

In one operation, pick two distinct indices i and j, where words[i] is a non-empty string, and move any character from words[i] to any position in words[j].

Return true if you can make every string in words equal using any number of operations, and false otherwise.

Example 1:

Input: words = ["abc","aabc","bc"]
Output: true
Explanation: Move the first 'a' in words[1] to the front of words[2], to make words[1] = "abc" and words[2] = "abc". All the strings are now equal to "abc", so return true.

Example 2:

Input: words = ["ab","a"]
Output: false
Explanation: It is impossible to make all the strings equal using the operation.

Constraints:

    1 <= words.length <= 100
    1 <= words[i].length <= 100
    words[i] consists of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def makeEqual(self, words: List[str]) -> bool:
        from collections import Counter

        total_count = Counter()
        n = len(words)
        for word in words:
            total_count.update(word)
        for count in total_count.values():
            if count % n != 0:
                return False
        return True


sol = Solution()

print(sol.makeEqual(["abc", "aabc", "bc"]))  # True

assert sol.makeEqual(["abc", "aabc", "bc"]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["ab", "a"]) == False

assert sol.makeEqual(["a"]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["a", "a", "a"]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["abc", "abc", "abc"]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["abc", "def", "ghi"]) == False
assert sol.makeEqual(["aaa", "aaa", "aaa"]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["abc", "ab", "a"]) == False
assert sol.makeEqual(["a" * 100] * 100) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["a" * 100, "b" * 100]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["abcde"] * 99 + ["abcde"]) == True
assert sol.makeEqual(["abc", "abc", "abcd"]) == False
assert sol.makeEqual(["abc", "abc", "abcc"]) == False
assert sol.makeEqual(["a" * 50 + "b" * 50] * 2) == True
